# 🔢 Bayesian Analysis of Syntopy

Here is the documentation of my statistical assignment for the course Bayesian Statistics.

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
This is the analysis of simulated data with **R**, mainly with the library `Rethinking`. A syntopy is simulated for two spatial scales using **Fisher's non-central hypergeometric distribution** and the true values are estimated with models in [**Stan**](https://mc-stan.org/).
:::

[**View Bayesian Assignment →**](https://matejtvar.github.io/Bayesian_syntopy/){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm role="button"}

# 🌎 Environmental and Spatial Predictors of Bird Diversity across the US

Here you can check my final assignement of [Spatial Data Science for Social Geography course](https://martinfleischmann.net/sds/), which is a computational essey written in 🐍**python** using **JupyterLab**.

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
This is the route-based analysis of species richness across the contiguous United States, using The North American Breeding Bird Survey (BBS) data - routes as the observational units and combination of environmental (NDVI) and spatial (elevation, LONG, LAT) predictors.
:::

[**View Assignement →**](https://matejtvar.github.io/SDS-assignment/){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm role="button"}
